Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of treating Argininosuccinate Synthetase Deficiency (ASD) in a human subject, the method comprising administering to the subject in need of treatment a composition comprising an mRNA encoding argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS1) encapsulated within a liposome comprising one or more cationic lipids, one or more non-cationic lipids, one or more cholesterol-based lipids and one or more PEG-modified lipids at an effective dose and an administration interval such that at least one symptom or feature of the ASD is reduced in intensity, severity, or frequency or has its onset delayed.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the liposome comprises one or more cationic lipids, one or more non-cationic lipids, one or more cholesterol-based lipids and one or more PEG-modified lipids.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises the one or more cationic lipids, the one or more non-cationic lipids, the one or more cholesterol-based lipids and the one or more PEG-modified lipids.

Claim 4 (Originally presented): The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise a cationic lipid selected from the group consisting of C12-200, MC3, DLinDMA, DLinkC2DMA, cKK-E12, ICE (Imidazol-based), HGT5000, HGT5001, DODAC, DDAB, DMRIE, DOSPA, DOGS, DODAP, DODMA and DMDMA, DODAC, DLenDMA, DMRIE, CLinDMA, CpLinDMA, DMOBA, DOcarbDAP, DLinDAP, DLincarbDAP, DLinCDAP, KLin-K-DMA, DLin-K-XTC2-DMA, HGT4003, and combinations thereof.

Claim 5 (Originally presented): The method of claim 4, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise cKK-E12.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cholesterol-based lipids are cholesterol and/or PEGylated cholesterol.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cationic lipids constitute about 30-50% of the liposome by weight.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3, wherein the ratio of cationic lipid:non-cationic lipid:cholesterol:PEGylated lipid is approximately 40:30:20:10 by molar ratio.

Claim 9 (Originally presented): The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises a combination selected from: cKK-E12, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; C12-200, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; HGT4003, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; or ICE, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K.

Claim 10 (Originally presented): The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome has a size less than about 100 nm.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the effective dose ranges from about 0.1 - 5.0 mg/kg body weight.

Claim 12 (Originally presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered intravenously.

Claim 13 (Originally presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered once a week.

Claim 14 (Cancelled).

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced citrulline level in the subject as compared to the baseline citrulline level before the treatment, thereby treating the ASD.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced ammonia level in the subject as compared to the baseline ammonia level before the treatment, thereby treating the ASD.

Claim 17 (Originally presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is codon optimized.

Claim 18 (Originally presented): The method of claim 17, wherein the codon-optimized mRNA comprises SEQ ID NO:3.

Claim 19 (Originally presented): The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA comprises one or more modified nucleotides.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is unmodified and the composition is administered intravenously at an effective dose ranging from about 0.1 - 5.0 mg/kg body weight once a week to a human subject.
